title: ctenopteris pediculata
intro: Ctenopteris pediculata, commonly known as the New Zealand fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its health benefits, which include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Ctenopteris pediculata include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it a popular natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects on human health.
